hamstrings.note: hinge credit + LEG FLEXION credit (separate segment)

bucket_credit_map.ISO_SIDE_REAR_DELT: by exercise: side raises/upright rows -> side_delts 1.0; reverse flies/face pulls -> rear_delts 1.0; front raises -> front_delts 1.0

second exercise of the same category on a main day
small muscle moved to the start of the session

effort.strength_main_lift: RPE 7 -> 9 over a wave; deload RPE 7; test week RPE 10
effort.plyo_throw_sprint: max intent, never to fatigue; stop when quality drops; plyos 'EASY'
effort.failure_methods: MYO/AMRAP only on the last exercise; MAX/ALL only on the last two slots; generator restricts technical failure to isolation or constraint >= 4 (coach setting)

pairing.opposite_dominance: complete sessions: bootcamp, 2-3 days/week, in-season athletes, heavy/fast main lift (G2/G3)

zone-preserving athletic substitute (flag zone_shift) or nearest pattern (flag pattern_gap) + buy list

allowed_overrides: contrast / French contrast station (athletic, strength; off/pre-season; intermediate+)
easy C aerobic or the day's sprint stimulus first

engine.tag: CHAT mechanism + OBS whole-set steps; rule INF
engine.target: target_k = start * (1 + rate) ** (k - 1)  # k = loading-week index, deloads skipped

release.after_release: hold weeks while the target catches up

readiness_gate.RED: 'Felt a PAIN' or "10 - I'm done": no release; pain swap; -1 set; rate 0 until 2 clean exposures
readiness_gate.AMBER: '9 - That was terrible' or 'Felt the WRONG muscle': hold; bank accrues; change one variable if WRONG muscle
readiness_gate.GREEN: EFFORT 6-8 and 'Felt the RIGHT muscles': release per rule
readiness_gate.EASY: EFFORT 1-5: raise load or reps first (double progression)

placement: fixed block menu of 2-3 exercises per muscle
round robin, never the same exercise twice in a row
an exercise that gets a new set holds load that week

modes.TEMPLATE_STEP: +1 set per exercise every 2-3 weeks (his 12-week products)

goal_modifiers.hypertrophy: class rate on sets; double progression elsewhere
goal_modifiers.fat_loss: <= 3 % on sets; isolation reps stepped; circuit density
goal_modifiers.strength: load +5 % every 2 weeks with RPE 7 -> 9; main-lift sets ~5 %; accessories hold
goal_modifiers.athlete_off_pre: quality and exposure first (plyo zone, force phase, contacts +10-15 % per 2-week step); resistance 0-3 %

engine.load_progression: double progression: hold load until all sets hit the top of the bracket at target RIR, then +2.5-5 kg lower / +1-2.5 kg upper / next DB pair; home: reps -> tempo -> ROM -> sets before load

variation.default: block_fixed (VP-1): exercises fixed 4-6 weeks; weekly change only sets/reps/load/RIR

options.ab_two_menu: strength / fat-loss tracks or variety-seeking clients (VP-2)
options.zone_constant_rotation: athletic accessory slots only (VP-3); skill anchors fixed >= 8 weeks

variation.between_blocks: ONE small variable per slot; <= 1/3 of slots fully replaced
never: new exercise in a deload week
level promotion as a variation engine (CAT-05)
variation.exception: conditioning colours must change weekly ('Never do the same color workout in the same week')

8.week8: deload (hypertrophy, fat loss, general) or test on ME days + deload on DE days (strength, athlete)

12.week12: peak or test; intensifiers in weeks 9-12 (hypertrophy)

6.end: peak; next plan opens with a deload

plan_shapes.athlete_8_build: 2-week base + 6-week conversion in 2-week steps; week 7 mini-deload; week 8 peak (OBS boxer)

deload.dose: same exercises and frequency; sets = round(min(0.85 * W1, 0.75 * peak)); main lifts ~3 x 8 @ RPE ~7
deload.athletic: plyos 1-2 sets of landings / low amplitude; contacts -50-70 %
early_triggers: 2 consecutive weeks with EFFORT 9-10 on >= 30 % of logged sets
'Felt a PAIN' on >= 2 slots in one week
load/reps falling on >= 3 main lifts for 2 exposures
deload.restart: wave-1 midpoint, never the last peak
deload.taper: 1-2 weeks before season/fight: volume -40-60 %, intensity and frequency kept, no new exercises
deload.recovery_week_throwers: arm care + mobility + 'Paced Cardio - easy' 4 x 10 min; no main lifts (OBS BASEBALL B1 wk 8)
deload.after_unwritten_peak: append a deload/taper week if the plan continues

autoregulation.EFFORT 1-5: load or reps up first, then scheduled release
autoregulation.EFFORT 10: -1 set on that slot; counts toward early deload
autoregulation.Felt the RIGHT muscles: keep; eligible for one level step next block
autoregulation.Felt the WRONG muscle: change one variable in the same column
autoregulation.Felt a PAIN: pain rule, -1 set, rate 0 until 2 pain-free exposures
autoregulation.Couldn't do it: one level down or assisted; dose unchanged

validation_checks.V1: F01 any yes / F36 severe / F37 yes -> refer to coach, no automatic plan
validation_checks.V4: 30 min + athlete -> warning (1 plyo + triple ext + 2 supersets)
validation_checks.V5: age < 15 -> foundational/moderate bodyweight plyos, no maximal lifts, no floor Olympic lifts, medball 4-6 lb
validation_checks.V6: age >= 65 -> constraint 4-5, no Olympic, depth jumps, hurdle hops, bounding; fast machine work first
validation_checks.V7: plan longer than weeks to season -> cut + taper or switch to in-season at the date
validation_checks.V9: sport needs throws, no medball -> flag gap + buy list (no silent quality swap)
validation_checks.V10: no equipment + muscle goal -> warn: no true vertical pull, biceps or throwing
validation_checks.V13: lower-limb pain + jump sport -> impact filter
validation_checks.V14: excludes running -> machine conditioning by time/calories
validation_checks.V15: strength goal excludes barbell -> warn; offer DB/machine strength

pipeline.name: derive
pipeline.do: D1-D8: family, profile, client level, ladder, phase, client family + constraint band, kit

pipeline.name: pick_template
pipeline.do: skeleton = periodization skeleton[family][phase][weeks]; week = templates split[family][days] (or BASEBALL Parts / boxing build-up); place on weekdays; stations at 60 min then fit to minutes; add athletic prefix from the sport dials

pipeline.name: allocate_weekly_sets
pipeline.do: per muscle: peak from rule_tables.weekly_sets (x multipliers, + focus), rate by size, start back-solved, floors, caps; athletic dials x season x level; distribute to slots within session budget and the bilateral:unilateral target

pipeline.name: choose_exercises
pipeline.do: per slot: library bucket -> operative level <= ceiling -> kit -> pain -> exclusions -> substitution ladder -> score (coach usage, coach preference, constraint fit, zone fit, lengthened bias, skill, pain, continuity); twins for 2nd exposure; flag laterality_shift

pipeline.name: set_dose
pipeline.do: reps (matrix x size x preference), effort by class, rest by goal, load format by implement (% needs F20), medball lb, contacts/throws/cuts

pipeline.name: order_sessions
pipeline.do: ordering.tiers + within-tier sort + allowed overrides; validate R5, H-before-V, knee+pull/hip+push, frequency invariant, >= 1 OFF day

pipeline.name: progress_weekly
pipeline.do: progression.engine per loading week with the readiness gate; double progression; athletic quality ladders; variation policy

pipeline.name: audit_render
pipeline.do: sets vs targets/caps/floors; contacts vs tiers and NSCA per-session caps; colours never repeated; bilateral share; render coach labels and instruction lines; reps as text
